stories.why: The previous path had an ambiguous repair owner, so validation failures could leak into orchestration decisions.

slides.title: Where repair ownership creates coupling
slides.content:
The ambiguous repair owner made the retry boundary the governing constraint.

| Option | Effect |
|---|---|
| upstream repair | exposes validation internals to orchestration |
| local repair | keeps failure handling inside validation |

slides.title: The local repair and fallback path
slides.content:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Validate[validate] --> Repair[repair locally]
  Repair --> Validate
  Repair -->|budget exhausted| Fallback[orchestration fallback]
```

The retry budget controls the branch; ownership remains in validation.
